description: This file contains utility functions for unit testing, including time retrieval and element presence checking in RBUS components, with included headers for gtest and RBUS libraries.

methods.name: getCompileTime
methods.description: Populates a struct tm with the compile time based on __DATE__ and __TIME__ macros.

methods.name: isElementPresent
methods.description: Checks for the presence of a specific RBUS component element, retrying until found.
